rework.instructionsText:
CMP LASER ENDPOINT RE-CALIBRATION.
A silicon-nitride stop layer protects the active areas while the overlying oxide fill is polished away. The endpoint is the moment oxide clears and nitride is exposed — the optical signal changes because Si3N4 has a higher refractive index than SiO2.
Calibrate the interferometer: set wavelength and gain so the fringe signal is legible, then match the phase so the measured curve lines up with the reference.
Correct alignment locks the polisher automated safety braking for the next 5 wafers, which prevents the structural dishing an unbraked tool would cause.
stepDescriptions: CALIBRATE — set wavelength and gain until the fringe signal is legible
ALIGN — match phase until the trace reproduces the reference
LOCK — confirm the endpoint and engage the safety brake

bench.title: CMP LASER ENDPOINT — INTERFEROMETER CALIBRATION
bench.instrument: A laser interferometer viewing the pad through a window, with gain, wavelength and phase trims.

steps.label: CALIBRATE — WAVELENGTH AND GAIN
steps.purpose: Make the reflected fringe signal legible before trusting any endpoint.
steps.chemistry: Laser interferometry through the pad window

steps.label: ALIGN — PHASE TO REFERENCE
steps.purpose: Match the measured curve to the stored reference so the knee reads at the right thickness.
steps.chemistry: Phase trim against the stored endpoint reference

steps.label: LOCK — ENGAGE SAFETY BRAKE
steps.purpose: Arm the polisher brake for the next 5 wafers and prevent structural dishing.

rework.instructionsText:
RCA CLEAN — twin-tank wet bench.
SC-1 is alkaline peroxide (NH4OH/H2O2) and lifts organic film and particles. SC-2 is acidic peroxide (HCl/H2O2) and lifts heavy-metal ions; it does NOT etch silicon. Both are needed, in that order, and SC-2 runs far cooler than SC-1.
A megasonic DI rinse sits between every bath. Skipping it carries peroxide and alkali forward and poisons the next bath.
Heat each tank to its own window BEFORE immersing, then hold the dwell. Under-soaking leaves active metal; over-soaking attacks the substrate boundary.
stepDescriptions: SC-1 — alkaline organic / particle clean at 70-80 C, 10 min soak
QDR — megasonic DI rinse, ambient, 5 min
SC-2 — acidic metal-ion clean at 30-40 C, 10 min soak
QDR — final megasonic DI rinse, ambient, 5 min

bench.title: RCA CLEAN — DUAL-TANK WET BENCH
bench.instrument: Two independently heated tanks with separate controllers, and a megasonic QDR between them.

steps.label: SC-1 — ALKALINE ORGANIC / PARTICLE CLEAN
steps.purpose: Lift organic film, particles, and native-oxide regrowth before the gate oxide grows.
steps.removes: Organic film, particles, native oxide regrowth

steps.label: QDR — MEGASONIC DI RINSE
steps.purpose: Stop alkaline and peroxide carryover from contaminating the acid bath.
steps.removes: Carryover of alkaline and peroxide between baths

steps.label: SC-2 — ACIDIC METAL-ION CLEAN
steps.purpose: Oxidatively desorb and complex away metal ions that SC-1 cannot reach.
steps.removes: Heavy-metal ions, alkali residue, metal hydroxides

steps.label: QDR — FINAL MEGASONIC RINSE
steps.purpose: Leave the wafer clean and at ambient for transfer to the next tool.

rework.instructionsText:
SELECTIVE SILICIDE WET ETCH — ultrasonic strip station.
The stringer is still strippable only while the film is high-resistance C49 titanium silicide. Watch the sheet resistance: C49 reads 60-90 uOhm.cm, C54 reads 12-15.
Trigger the ultrasonic wash inside the C49 window, then STOP. The bath is selective for titanium against SiO2/SiN/Si, but it is NOT selective against the titanium contact it must preserve — over-washing thins the contact until its resistance climbs, and running past the window locks a permanent bridge into the circuit.
At 45 nm the C49-to-C54 conversion is retarded, so the window is narrow. This is why silicide bridging is a crisis at this node and would be routine at 90 nm.
stepDescriptions: RAMP — bring the wafer up to the formation anneal and watch Rs fall
WASH — fire the ultrasonic strip inside the C49 window
CONVERSION — complete the anneal to C54 and verify the contact

bench.title: SELECTIVE SILICIDE WET ETCH — ULTRASONIC STRIP STATION
bench.instrument: A four-point sheet-resistance readout integrated with an ultrasonic bath timer.

steps.label: FORMATION ANNEAL — WATCH Rs FALL
steps.purpose: Form the initial titanium silicide and watch it convert C49 to C54.
steps.chemistry: Forming anneal, 450-650 C for C49, 850-900 C for C54
steps.removes: n/a — this step forms the film that the wash strips

steps.label: ULTRASONIC STRIP WASH
steps.purpose: Lift unreacted pathway titanium while the lattice is still C49 and strippable.
steps.chemistry: NH4OH : H2O2 : H2O = 1 : 3 : 5 at room temperature
steps.removes: Stray titanium stringers on the sidewall spacers

steps.label: CONVERSION ANNEAL — VERIFY CONTACT
steps.purpose: Complete C54 formation and confirm the preserved contact resistance is in spec.
steps.removes: n/a — this step locks the contact
